scope: bounded section mesh cache, persistent snapshot worker, partial CPU remeshing and appearance camera retention
checks: unchanged sections reused; boundary halo rebuilt and compared byte-for-byte with uncached geometry/picking
negative/unaligned origins, opaque/blended ranges and overhangs preserved
actual transferable output leaves worker cache reusable; snapshot sent only once
slices/empty views, bounded LRU eviction and oversized section bypass preserve output
cancelled jobs and invalid clips cannot commit; fatal worker errors recreate the snapshot
renderer reuses sessions across clips, skips equivalent bounds and preserves appearance camera
same committed input reuses validated volume; new atlas gets a fresh geometry cache
failed staged upload retains committed session/picker/atlas; clear disposes pending work
limits: Focused Node worker transfers and controlled renderer canvas/device only. CPU section reuse still flattens/transfers/uploads the complete visible mesh. Cache budget covers payload bytes plus per-entry allowance, not total browser/driver memory; staged snapshots can coexist. No native build, terrain generation, registry/state sweep, broad suite or GitHub workflow. Real browser/GPU and performance qualification remain pending.
